name: A Phase Past One And Gaits Out Of Order
_warns: Two things that load and are still worth saying. The leg's `phase` is 1.25, and `Leg.measure` runs it through `fposmod`, so it means 0.25 — an author who wrote it meaning 'a quarter of a cycle after the one before' got what they meant by accident, and one who meant 'one and a quarter cycles' did not, so the warning states the number it becomes rather than only that the range is wrong. The gaits are written trot-then-walk, and `Gait._usable` sorts them before blending, so the order changes nothing at all — its comment says the validator is what says so, and this is the asset that proves it does.
